newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab Air Carriers Organisation members call for alliance to fight competition from European airlines.
- Agriculture and water minister signs contracts worth 155 million riyals to supply drinking water in a number of villages.
- Saudi Arabia eases travel restrictions imposed on Nigerians last year following an outbreak of diseases in which several thousand Nigerians died.
- Around 12 percent of non-oil production in Saudi Arabia in 1995 was from the agricultural sector.
